purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
The WM-ECO-024 parent signal and every sibling edge remain provisional rather than canonical.
Return request, eligibility, authorization, custody, receipt, inspection, disposition, adjustment, refund execution, settlement and dispute identities remain separate.
Item, quantity, condition, amount, currency, authority, jurisdiction, privacy and interoperability qualifiers remain explicit.
UNECE and IFRS source-access limitations remain visible.
Every external mapping is version-pinned, profile-qualified and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The case boundary is coherent and does not absorb neighboring commerce, logistics, inventory, finance, legal, safety or records masters.
Goods, services, digital content, access and non-return refund paths remain profiles rather than one universal lifecycle.
Request, eligibility, authorization, return movement, receipt, inspection, disposition, credit, instruction, execution and settlement are not treated as equivalent.
Refund calculation distinguishes subject, quantity, amount, currency, tax, fees, discounts, deductions, allocation, rule version and source.
Corrections, retries, appeals, disputes and reopening preserve prior evidence and independent external effects.
Autonomous legal eligibility, custody, disposition, accounting, payment, disclosure and destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
